name: 奶油奶香手剥夏威夷果款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规的白底主图
一秒传达奶香酥脆的核心利益，深色场衬托果仁
放大受潮软壳与徒手难开的吃坚果痛点，引出随袋开口器
证明随袋开口器轻拧即开的省力体验，消除难剥疑虑
代入追剧下午茶的真实解馋场景，触发场景联想
微距呈现果仁表面的奶脂光泽与完整弧面，证明饱满口感
俯拍呈现密封袋装与随附开口器的完整内容，降低决策风险
以囤货组合收口促单，留出优惠文案位

style.backgroundSystem: buttercream #FDF8EE studio fields for packshot and info shots, deep cocoa #3E2A1D and roasted-shell brown #75512F fields for mood and closing shots, warm sanded-wood #C89F62 and oat linen #E9DCC4 as table surfaces

style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm creamy snack visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of buttercream #FDF8EE, roasted-shell brown #75512F, deep cocoa #3E2A1D and one macadamia-leaf green accent #7C9E62; soft warm key light from the upper left with gentle fill and soft contact shadows; modern rounded sans-serif; consistent thin-line icon style; appetizing natural food photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product scale with loose natural scatter presentation; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle for the pouch, piles of the product always read as loose natural scatter, never geometric grids
style.surfaceSystem: sanded light-wood board #C89F62, oat linen cloth #E9DCC4, matte pale cocoa paper #F6EFE0
